smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001632830.title: Deputy manager_eAxle EMC & HV safety engineer
smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001632830.text:
Company Description
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive technology, industrial technology, consumer goods, energy and building technology. In India, the Group operates through six subsidiaries with a combined associate strength of around 26,000 and a group

turnover of around Rs. 13,200 crores in 2013. In India Bosch Limited is the flagship company of the Bosch Group. Over and above a strong presence in the India Automotive services sector, Bosch in India has a vast service network that spans across 1,000 towns and cities with over 3000 service outlets. As the largest auto component supplier in the country, setting a benchmark in the sectors it operates in, the company has to its credit several laurels. We invite promising and dynamic professionals for a long-term and rewarding career with Bosch.
Job Description
**Key Responsibilities:**
execute electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and high-voltage (HV) safety development activities for e-Axle projects
Develop and implement EMC concepts and strategies for e-Axle systems to meet market requirements
Design and evaluate EMC filter topologies to optimize system performance and compliance
Manage and prioritize EMC-related customer requests and technical inquiries
Present EMC and HV safety topics to internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts
Create comprehensive EMC test plans and document test results for customer deliverables
Ensure compliance with local and international EMC regulations and standards applicable to target markets
Derive and cascade component-level requirements to guarantee adherence to legal and safety requirements across all target markets
Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for EMC and safety-related issues

Release HV Safety targets and assesss maturity level of sample

Coordinate and Define HV Safety Design in cooperation with HV Safety Experts

Perform/analyze HV Safety measurements on test bench and vehicle

HV Safety releases of eAxle for series production

Risk analysis for special releases

Coordination of HV Safety measurements for type and 100% testing with development and production plant
Qualifications
**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Power Electronics Engineering
Minimum 8 years of professional experience in automotive EMC & HV safety engineering, including electrified powertrain, inverter, or high-voltage systems
Demonstrated expertise in EMC filter design, topology optimization, and system-level EMC strategy development
Proven experience with HV safety development, assessment, and compliance for automotive applications
Strong knowledge of international EMC standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 26262, ISO 13849, relevant market-specific requirements)
Hands-on experience with EMC testing methodologies, measurement equipment, and test bench evaluation
Experience in risk assessment and mitigation strategies for safety-critical systems
Proficiency in technical documentation, test planning, and requirement management
Certification in automotive safety standards (e.g., ISO 26262 functional safety)
**Preferred Qualifications:**
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Electrical Engineering or related discipline
Specific experience with e-Axle or electric motor drive systems development
Familiarity with HV safety measurement techniques and vehicle-level testing protocols
Proficiency with EMC simulation software and design tools
Additional Information

smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:7440001632809.text:
Company Description
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive technology, industrial technology, consumer goods, energy and building technology. In India, the Group operates through six subsidiaries with a combined associate strength of around 26,000 and a group

turnover of around Rs. 13,200 crores in 2013. In India Bosch Limited is the flagship company of the Bosch Group. Over and above a strong presence in the India Automotive services sector, Bosch in India has a vast service network that spans across 1,000 towns and cities with over 3000 service outlets. As the largest auto component supplier in the country, setting a benchmark in the sectors it operates in, the company has to its credit several laurels. We invite promising and dynamic professionals for a long-term and rewarding career with Bosch.
Job Description
This position is responsible for end-to-end ordering and tracking of eAxle engineering development parts, ensuring timely availability for development, build and validation activities. The role coordinates with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Purchasing, Logistics, Suppliers, Finance and Test Facilities; monitors engineering budgets; and supports test-bench demand, capacity and schedule planning.
Key Responsibilities:
 
Collect, validate and consolidate engineering development-part requirements, including specification, quantity, required date, project, cost centre and delivery location.
Initiate and follow up purchase requisitions, purchase orders and related approvals in coordination with Engineering and Purchasing.
Maintain an end-to-end ordering tracker covering request status, supplier confirmation, expected delivery, logistics status, receipt and open issues.
Coordinate with Purchasing, Logistics, Suppliers, Finance, Warehousing and Project Teams to resolve commercial, shipping, customs, invoice and delivery constraints.
Monitor engineering budget commitments and actual costs; prepare periodic budget status, forecast, variance and management reports.
Consolidate test-bench demand, support capacity and slot planning, track booking and readiness, and highlight schedule conflicts or risks.
Conduct regular status reviews, drive escalation of critical shortages and budget or test-bench risks, and ensure traceable documentation and timely stakeholder communication.
Monitor supplier performance metrics and maintain collaborative relationships to ensure quality, delivery and cost objectives are met.
Identify potential supply chain risks and bottlenecks; develop and implement mitigation strategies to minimize project delays.
Maintain data integrity within ordering systems and tools; provide accurate reporting and analytics to support decision-making across stakeholder groups.
Qualifications
**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the following areas: engineering operations, development-part ordering, procurement coordination, logistics coordination, budget tracking, or test-resource planning
Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, order management tools, and data analytics platforms
Strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear reports and present findings to cross-functional stakeholders
**Preferred Qualifications:**
Professional experience in the automotive industry or electrification/electric vehicle sector
Demonstrated experience in supplier relationship management and performance monitoring
Proven track record in supply chain risk identification, mitigation strategy development, and implementation
Familiarity with test-bench operations, capacity planning, or resource scheduling
Experience with budget forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting
Knowledge of logistics, customs procedures, and international shipping requirements
Certification in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, or related field (APICS, CSCP, or equivalent)
Additional Information

smartrecruiters:NielsenIQ:74400016329209.text:
Company Description

Job Description
Job Summary 
We are seeking a highly skilled Python & Generative AI Engineer (3–4 years experience) to design, build, and optimize scalable, cloud-native AI applications. This role blends hands-on development, system design, and applied AI engineering, with a focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs). 
The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience in distributed systems and AI-driven applications, capable of owning features end-to-end while contributing to architecture, performance optimization, and model fine-tuning workflows. 
Role: Python & Generative AI Engineer  
Responsibilities 
Develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality backend applications using Python, FastAPI, and cloud-native technologies. 
Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices with a focus on performance, reliability, security, and maintainability. 
Develop and integrate Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases. 
Build AI-powered services leveraging Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI application frameworks. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI-powered applications throughout the software development lifecycle. 
Implement efficient data retrieval and knowledge grounding solutions using embeddings, semantic search, and vector stores. 
Ensure application quality through unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices. 
Implement observability using structured logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring tools to ensure operational excellence. 
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security scanning, and deployment processes. 
Participate in design discussions, technical reviews, and mentoring of junior engineers. 
Continuously evaluate emerging AI frameworks, models, and engineering practices to improve solution quality and developer productivity. ​‌
Qualifications
3-5 years of software development experience. 

1+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications. 
 
Must-Have Skills 
Python Development 

Strong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming. 

Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django. 

Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and API development. 

Knowledge of design patterns, clean code principles, and software engineering best practices. 
Generative AI & LLM Engineering 

Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications. 

Experience with prompt engineering techniques. 

Experience designing and implementing RAG applications. 

Familiarity with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Qdrant. 

Experience working with embedding models and semantic search. 
AI Frameworks 

Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks. 

Familiarity with AI agent development concepts and workflows. 
API & Backend Development 

Strong experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs. 

Experience working with JSON, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, pagination, and error handling patterns. 
Databases 

Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent relational databases. 

Experience with ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy. 

Understanding of transaction management and query optimization. 
Messaging & Distributed Systems 

Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar messaging platforms. 

Understanding of microservices and distributed system fundamentals. 
Testing & Quality 

Experience with PyTest and automated testing frameworks. 

Familiarity with code quality tools and static code analysis. 
Cloud & DevOps 

Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

Experience with Docker and containerized applications. 

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. 

Strong knowledge of Git and modern development workflows. 
Observability 

Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack, or Azure Monitor. 

Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. 
 
Good-to-Have Skills 

Experience with fine-tuning open-source LLMs or Small Language Models (SLMs). 

Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search. 

Exposure to Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or Bicep). 

Knowledge of agentic AI workflows and multi-agent architectures. 

Experience with model evaluation frameworks and LLM observability. 

Familiarity with GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted software development. 

Exposure to ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow. 

Prior experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
